title: Analyzing and Improving Fast Sampling of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
tldr_zh: 消融 T2I 免训练五组件，外调度最关键；Frenet–Serret 总旋转等分调度，Flux 10 步达 20 步基线
tldr_en: Ablates five training-free T2I acceleration components; schedule dominates. TORS equidistributes Frenet-Serret total rotation; Flux.1-Dev 10 steps match 20-step baseline.
key_numbers: Flux.1-Dev 10 steps: TORS HPSv2 29.30 vs baseline 27.70 vs GITS 29.13; 20-step baseline 29.30 (Table 1a)
SD 3.5 medium 10 steps: TORS IR 0.86 vs baseline 0.55 vs UniPC 0.69 (Table 1b)
GenEval Flux overall: TORS 10 steps 0.67 vs 50-step baseline 0.65 (Table 2)
Top-3 PCs explain >99% variance of 100 Flux trajectories (Sec. 5.1)
Qwen-Image 10 steps IR 0.91 -> 1.12 with Flux-derived TORS schedule (Table 3)
Deeper cache adds 6-14% latency, VRAM 36.32 -> up to 42.78 GB (Sec. 4)
